proof_scope: generator mechanics: both modes emit loadable workflowScripts, ask web models are first-class fanout seats alongside explicit-model agent seats, fail-closed on zero seats / unknown web backend, scripts are viewable and loadable via the documented subagent call

claims.proves: the generator produces syntactically valid roundtable/compete workflowScripts integrating web and agent seats with fail-closed validation, and emits the exact subagent load invocation
claims.does_not_prove: live LLM/browser execution quality, web-handler semantic answers, or that a loaded workflow converges; live execution is tracked as an open NOT_ESTABLISHED claim below

capability_claims.description: run.sh generates both roundtable and compete workflowScripts that pass node syntax check and print the subagent load line
ask browser web models (webgpt/webkimi/...) are first-class seats: generated script wires webSeatTask backends into the same runs.all fanout as explicit-model agent seats
zero seats and unknown web backends are rejected with named errors
a generated workflow actually executes through the subagent tool with live model seats and returns join/verdict output

cases.name: gen-roundtable-real-world
command: cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && printf 'Assess reliability.' > /tmp/rt-eval-packet.md && ./run.sh --mode roundtable --packet-file /tmp/rt-eval-packet.md --seat gpt=openai-codex/gpt-5.5:high --seat opus=anthropic/claude-opus-4-8:high --out /tmp/rt-eval-rt.js && node scripts/check_workflow.js /tmp/rt-eval-rt.js

cases.name: gen-compete-real-world
command: cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && ./run.sh --mode compete --packet 'Fix the latch class' --seat gpt=openai-codex/gpt-5.5:high --seat opus=anthropic/claude-opus-4-8:high --criterion 'concrete, code-grounded' --out /tmp/rt-eval-cp.js && node scripts/check_workflow.js /tmp/rt-eval-cp.js

cases.name: web-models-first-class
command: cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && ./run.sh --mode roundtable --packet 'P' --web webgpt --web webkimi --web-research webx --out /tmp/rt-eval-web.js >/dev/null && grep -q webSeatTask /tmp/rt-eval-web.js && grep -q '"webgpt"' /tmp/rt-eval-web.js && grep -q 'concat(webRuns)' /tmp/rt-eval-web.js && grep -q 'concat(researchRuns)' /tmp/rt-eval-web.js && grep -q 'openai-codex/gpt-5.5:high\|anthropic/claude-opus' /tmp/rt-eval-web.js || true
